275402784.description:
Cross
Writing Instrument Set - 14KT Gold Filled
Vintage, Includes Case and Refills
This vintage writing set from A.T. Cross Company represents the timeless elegance and precision engineering that has defined the brand since the mid-19th century. Featuring the slim silhouette characteristic of classic Cross designs, these instruments are finished in 14KT gold filled metal, offering a luxurious aesthetic combined with the durability required for daily use. The set includes a matte-finish mechanical pencil and a textured engine-turned ballpoint pen, showcasing the variety of decorative techniques employed by Cross during the mid-to-late 20th century.
14KT gold filled construction as indicated by the original interior warranty documentation
One mechanical pencil with a matte gold-tone finish and decorative center band
One ballpoint pen featuring a classic textured engine-turned pattern
Includes original brown branded hard case, fabric sleeve, and two medium ink refills (one in original gold tube)
Dimensions: Case measures approximately 7" x 3" x 2"
Condition:
Overall good vintage condition. The writing instruments show light surface wear and minor patina consistent with age and occasional use. The internal storage pouch and warranty paper are present. The hard case is structurally sound with a functional hinge, showing minor exterior scuffing. The items are untested for mechanical function or ink flow.
